changes.comment: Restructure the SASS. Every component stylesheet now imports one shared entry partial rather than six of fifteen importing a mixins file directly, and the fragments that were copied between them become mixins: the reduced-motion media query, two disabled treatments, the house transition and the elevated-surface treatment the modal and anchored tiers each had a private copy of. `form.css` becomes self-sufficient: `.yl-field` moves to the file whose component renders it, so `FormField` no longer silently needs `field.css` as well. A disabled checkbox now fades like the switch and slider it sits beside.
